services.desc: 2 Persons Allowed Per Car · Must Be Age 18+ to Drive · 400 lbs. Max Weight Duration 2 Hours About Experience an off-the-beaten-path tour in a unique way, with fantastic ocean vistas at every turn! Monterey Bay’s one and only talking car, is a two-seater scooter car, open on top so you get unobstructed views. Sea Car Tours is the best way to see one of the most beautiful areas in the world.
